component: Shared OAuth preference preprocessing and current getter

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The change places only the custom-scheme true preference and its comment inside #ifndef MOZ_ESR. The external-browser true preference remains outside. ESR preprocessing therefore omits this true default; the patch does not write false or clear a stored preference. The local lazy getter passes no explicit fallback argument, and its upstream fallback implementation is unpaired, so a final Boolean value is not inferred from this source alone. The existing authorization-selection proof separately shows external-loopback, eligible custom-scheme and internal-fallback branches; no flow, profile or build was executed.
title: The ESR OAuth patch omits a true default rather than assigning false
